terms.note: Use bias cognitivo for the project taxonomy; distorsione cognitiva is a useful search/user-language alias but can be broader in clinical contexts.
Use effetto ancoraggio for the named phenomenon and bias di ancoraggio when the sentence refers to the bias lens.
Bias di conferma is concise and common in Italian decision-science usage.
Explain the term in plain language on first use for a general audience.
Prefer competenza decisionale in headings; use a more conversational form when needed in running text.
Avoid implying that a technique can eliminate bias; use riduzione or mitigazione according to context.
Use evidenze for research context; use prove only when the source truly supports the stronger everyday meaning.
Prefer action-oriented wording in practical checklists.
